description_excerpt: Job Description The scope of on-site support services is as following: • Testing status collection; • Consolidation of project tracker; • Coordination with vendors and labs; • Update outstanding status to Technologists; • QA daily tasks support (e.g. cross-check with IM comment…); and • QMT administrative tasks. Qualifications University graduated. Fluent in English & Ms Office Additional Information • One (01) year contract. • Working hours: from 09:00 to 18:00 (with 01-hour meal-time from 12:00 to 13:00), Monday to Friday. • Overtime: additional charge rate will follow the applicable law…
